aes_key_wrap.note: AES key wrap RFC 3394, not strictly AEAD

arbre.note: HTML builder DSL; closest to code-driven markup building

bcrypt_pbkdf.note: bcrypt-based KDF, not password hashing proper

bundler.note: dependency manager CLI, not a runtime task

capistrano.note: Remote deployment/SSH command tool; no matching category

cgi.note: CGI protocol support with assorted helpers; no clear single task

chunky_png.note: PNG-only codec with some pixel ops; borderline single-format codec

coercible.note: type coercion library, not record mapping

combine_pdf.note: merges/parses PDFs as well as creating

debase-ruby_core_source.note: ruby core source files for C extensions

docile.note: DSL block helper, no runtime task

dry-container.note: Simple item registry; no transitive dependency resolution

dry-inflector.note: inflection (camelize/underscore/etc) rather than pure case conversion

dry-logic.note: predicate rule composition used by dry-validation

dry-types.note: type system with coercions and constraints

encryptor.note: OpenSSL wrapper, default cipher may not be AEAD

escape.note: description is empty ellipsis; guessing string escaping

fog-xml.note: shared XML helpers of fog providers

formatador.note: STDOUT text formatting with color tags; unsure it is plain ANSI styling

locale.note: locale detection/localization APIs; may not do catalog lookup

mock_redis.note: in-memory Redis fake, excluded from redis-client

prawn-table.note: Prawn table plugin; needs Prawn to render

rackup.note: Rack server launcher command rather than a server itself

rbtrace.note: method call tracing of live process

ruby-graphviz.note: Graphviz graph layout is out of scope for chart-rendering

thrift.note: Thrift RPC bindings incl. binary protocol

tzinfo.note: time zone database package, excluded from date-time
